title: A Colony for the Terminal
author: Jonah Halloran
blurb: Quentin Ravensworth, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
